nodes.name: signed_table_add_extensional_unique

nodes.name: signed_table_add_exists
nodes.summary: Ordinary finite induction constructs both beta output streams and their actual packed table for pointwise add; no finite-choice or supplied-table oracle is used.

nodes.name: signed_table_add_exists_extensionally_unique
nodes.summary: Construct an actual pointwise add output and prove uniqueness of every represented entry; the raw table code is deliberately not claimed unique.

nodes.name: signed_table_multiply_exists_extensionally_unique

nodes.name: signed_table_scalar_exists_extensionally_unique
nodes.summary: Construct an actual pointwise scalar output and prove uniqueness of every represented entry; the raw table code is deliberately not claimed unique.

nodes.name: signed_table_add_reassociate
nodes.summary: Constructing the other parenthesization and applying literal signed-add functionality proves reverse associativity.

nodes.name: signed_table_add_medial
nodes.summary: The actual four canonical signed summands may be regrouped across two prefix/last-entry pairs, with a genuinely constructed intermediate sum.

nodes.name: signed_table_scalar_add_intro
nodes.summary: An actual sum of the two scalar products is the actual scalar multiple of the sum; no product witness or distributivity oracle is assumed.

nodes.name: signed_prefix_sum_pointwise_add
nodes.summary: Ordinary prefix induction proves that the actual sum of a witnessed pointwise table addition is the canonical signed sum of the two actual prefix sums, including length zero.

nodes.name: signed_prefix_sum_scalar_multiply
nodes.summary: Every actual prefix sum commutes with multiplication by an arbitrary canonical signed scalar, via genuine successor sums and distributivity; zero length and negative scalars are included.

nodes.name: signed_prefix_sum_pointwise_add_values_exist
nodes.summary: Construct all actual signed prefix-sum values and prove their addition relation, including the empty-prefix boundary.

nodes.name: signed_prefix_sum_scalar_multiply_values_exist
nodes.summary: Construct all actual signed prefix-sum values and prove their scalar product relation, including the empty-prefix boundary.

nodes.name: signed_weighted_sum_exists
nodes.summary: Construct the actual pointwise product table and both natural prefix-sum histories, then their canonical signed weighted-sum value.

nodes.name: signed_weighted_sum_functional
nodes.summary: Every genuine product-table witness gives the same canonical signed weighted sum, even when its raw beta codes and representatives differ.

nodes.name: signed_weighted_sum_exists_unique
nodes.summary: Every two valid input tables have a genuinely constructed, literally unique canonical signed weighted-sum value.

nodes.name: signed_weighted_sum_empty_value
nodes.summary: The empty weighted sum is canonical zero, regardless of the unused endpoint values of its valid table witnesses.

nodes.name: signed_weighted_sum_empty_exists
nodes.summary: Construct the real zero-length product table and signed fold; its output is then proved to be zero.

nodes.name: signed_table_weighted_add_distributive
nodes.summary: The actual pointwise product tables distribute over a witnessed pointwise addition; every entry is constructed and checked against canonical signed scalar distributivity.

nodes.name: signed_weighted_scalar_commute
nodes.summary: Construct the reordered product and identify its canonical value by signed multiplication associativity, commutativity and functionality.

nodes.name: signed_table_weighted_scalar_commute
nodes.summary: An arbitrary signed scalar commutes with an actual table of pointwise weighted products, with the same strict prefix window and actual table witnesses.

nodes.name: signed_weighted_sum_add_linearity
nodes.summary: Actual signed weighted sums are additive in their value table, by genuine pointwise product distributivity and the proved prefix-sum induction.

nodes.name: signed_weighted_sum_scalar_linearity
nodes.summary: Actual signed weighted sums commute with an arbitrary signed scalar; negative values, zero scalars and the empty prefix are included.

nodes.name: Lt
nodes.summary: Witness-defined strict order on natural numbers.

nodes.name: MatrixMinorFourCode
nodes.summary: One canonical injective doubled-Cantor code for all four signed-minor beta-code parameters.

nodes.name: Le
nodes.summary: Witness-defined non-strict order on natural numbers.

nodes.name: BetaAt
nodes.summary: x is the bounded beta-decoded value at index i.

nodes.name: SignedDecode
nodes.summary: The original canonical integer code: even 2p denotes p, and odd 2k+1 denotes −(k+1). The decoded positive and negative parts are normalized.

nodes.name: SignedBalance
nodes.summary: The original canonical code z represents the integer difference p−n; these supplied components need not be normalized.

nodes.name: ArithTable
nodes.summary: An actual packed signed table with canonical signed entries through index N, including index zero. It contains no divisor transform or inversion hypothesis.

nodes.name: ArithAt
nodes.summary: Two genuine beta entries of the packed table represent the unique canonical signed value z. Distinct component representations need not be equal.

nodes.name: ArithTableEqual
nodes.summary: Pointwise equality of actual canonical signed lookups below l, not equality of table codes or their positive/negative components.

nodes.name: ArithExtend
nodes.summary: A genuine output signed table through l preserves the represented source values at i<l and records the prescribed signed value z at l. Existence is proved by recoding both beta streams.

nodes.name: SignedAdd
nodes.summary: Actual addition of original canonical signed codes, witnessed by their decoders and balanced equality.

nodes.name: ArithAdd
nodes.summary: Three actual signed tables and witnessed SignedAdd entries at each i<l. The unused endpoint certified by ArithTable(l,...) is not included in the prefix sum.

nodes.name: SignedMul
nodes.summary: Actual multiplication of original canonical signed codes; opposite-sign products remain on the negative side of the balance.

nodes.name: ArithMul
nodes.summary: Three actual signed tables and witnessed SignedMul entries at each i<l; neither a finite-choice principle nor a product-of-sums identity is assumed.

nodes.name: ArithScale
nodes.summary: Actual source and output tables with witnessed multiplication of every represented entry below l by the signed scalar a. Sum distributivity is a separate theorem.

nodes.name: Sum
nodes.summary: z is the sum of a beta-coded prefix of length l.

nodes.name: SignedPrefixSum
nodes.summary: The signed balance of two actual natural finite sums, at exactly the indices 0<=i<l. Existence, uniqueness and representation independence are proved separately.

nodes.name: SignedWeightedSum
nodes.summary: An actual signed pointwise product table of weights W and values F, followed by its real signed prefix sum at indices i<l. No linearity, divisor cancellation or inversion is assumed in this graph.
